title: The divergence of a C¹ compactly supported vector field on ℝ^P is integrable with integral 0 (parent step 6)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and let φ : ℝ^P → ℝ^P (Euclid P) be C¹ (ContDiff ℝ 1) with compact support. Write div φ(z) := trace(Dφ(z)), the LinearMap.trace of fderiv ℝ φ z. Then div φ is Lebesgue integrable on ℝ^P and ∫_{ℝ^P} div φ dL^P = 0 (L^P = volume).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (φ : Euclid P → Euclid P), ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → Integrable (fun z => LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P)) ∧ ∫ z, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid P) (fderiv ℝ φ z : Euclid P →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P) = 0
